_doc: Doctrine #70 code-recency overlay (Ogie msg 8285, 2026-06-14). slug -> {code_date, repo, note}. code_date = the IN-SCOPE contract code's last-commit / deploy date (NOT the Immunefi listing scope-update-date, which can be a routine metadata touch masking old code — StakeStone anchor: scope-updated 2026-04 but stone-vault-v1 code 2024-07). The scorer's recency dimension PREFERS code_date when present (0.8 code + 0.2 launch), else falls back to the listing launch+updated blend. GROW THIS on every GATE-0: when you clone an in-scope repo, append {slug: {code_date: <git log -1 date>, repo}}. This permanently corrects the 'fresh listing != fresh code' false-positive.
